//: Deno configuration for the Edge Functions, and the reason it is HERE
rather than at the repository root.
`nodeModulesDir: auto` lets Deno resolve the npm packages the jsr
edge-runtime types pull in transitively (npm:openai, among others).
Without it `deno check` fails on resolution rather than on anything
But Deno creates that node_modules next to THIS file, and that
placement is the whole point. Run from the repository root, Deno
rewrites the root node_modules into its own layout and breaks the npm
toolchain sharing it — vitest starts failing with
ERR_PACKAGE_PATH_NOT_EXPORTED because it resolves vite through
node_modules/.deno. In CI that lands between the typecheck and the
test step and takes the whole build red; locally it breaks the
contributor's checkout with no clue as to why.
Scoped here, the two dependency trees never touch.
